path.fill: oklch(from oklch(from var(--base-color, #e63946) l c calc(h + 120)) calc(l + 0.15) c h)
oklch(from oklch(from var(--base-color, #e63946) l c calc(h + 120)) calc(l - 0.15) c h)
oklch(from oklch(from var(--base-color, #e63946) l c calc(h + 120)) l calc(c * 1.4) h)
oklch(from oklch(from var(--base-color, #e63946) 0.55 c h) l c calc(h + 60))
oklch(from oklch(from var(--base-color, #e63946) 0.55 c h) l c calc(h + 180))
oklch(from oklch(from var(--base-color, #e63946) 0.55 c h) l c h / 0.5)
oklch(from oklch(from var(--dark-accent, #f4a261) l c calc(h + 120)) calc(l + 0.15) c h)
oklch(from oklch(from var(--dark-accent, #f4a261) l c calc(h + 120)) calc(l - 0.15) c h)
oklch(from oklch(from var(--dark-accent, #f4a261) l c calc(h + 120)) l calc(c * 1.4) h)
oklch(from oklch(from var(--dark-accent, #f4a261) 0.55 c h) l c calc(h + 60))
oklch(from oklch(from var(--dark-accent, #f4a261) 0.55 c h) l c calc(h + 180))
oklch(from oklch(from var(--dark-accent, #f4a261) 0.55 c h) l c h / 0.5)
